gru-recipe.note: v1 GRU + weight EMA, cosine LR, 12 ep (baseline gru-v1 best 1.48)

ssm-recipe.note: v1 SSM + same recipe (baseline ssm-v1 best 1.51)

gru-w160.note: longer context windows (earlier SSM work used 140-280 frames)

gru-w160-h6.note: add 6 s displacement horizon: drift over long spans dominates error (Team 1, Team 11 oracle)

gru-w160-att.note: AirIO attitude encoding (gravity dir in body) as input [1 window/parent: equal compute]

gru-w160-h6-att.note: combine 6 s horizon + attitude [1 window/parent: equal compute]

gru-blind.note: diagnostic: identical to gru-recipe with images blanked; tests whether vision contributes

data-teacher-v2-gru-recipe.note: gru-recipe config on teacher-v2: 224 train shards (+100 generated)

ssm-w160-h6.note: leader SSM + longer context and 6 s horizon (equal compute)

data-teacher-v3-ssm-recipe.note: ssm-recipe config on teacher-v3: 322 train shards (+200 generated)

ssm-att.note: leader SSM + AirIO attitude input (10 epochs to finish by morning)

ssm-att-nopatience.note: rerun of ssm-att without early stopping (patience cut it mid-cosine at epoch 7)

data-teacher-v4-ssm-recipe.note: leader SSM on all generated data so far (v4), 6 epochs; runs into late morning, resumable
